scope: Offline public-source comparison; no protected source, network, CI, or Git used.
candidate_scan: Raw SHA-256/byte count for every candidate parse.rs plus exact body-token hash probes for target active changes; no pairwise candidate diffs.

limits: Syntactic direct calls only; method dispatch, macros, function pointers, actual branch conditions and source-file routing are not resolved.
Possible closure includes every syntactic branch and does not establish runtime reachability.

method.function_identity: Lexically located fn definitions; signatures and bodies use token hashes after comments/whitespace are omitted; literal contents remain represented by hashes.
method.whole_source_similarity: Exact byte hash, exact canonical token hash, and token-multiset overlap; top pair also gets a complete line diff.
method.ancestor_ranking: Target token retention, then target function-body token coverage, exact body count, and whole-source token Dice. Ranking is a static proximity screen, not proof of authorship lineage.
method.interpretation_boundary: Source similarity cannot establish runtime causality, quality, speed, formal acceptance, admission, ranking, or reward. Submission IDs and metrics are not used to infer novelty.

limits: The lightweight lexer is not a Rust parser; macro-generated functions, conditional compilation, method resolution, and type-level semantics may be missed.
The call graph is syntactic and includes all branches; it does not prove which file classes or branches run.
Token identity ignores whitespace and comments but distinguishes literal content; it is not semantic equivalence.
Candidate scan covers all existing candidates/parse.rs and all reference parse.rs; it does not inspect arbitrary evidence payloads or private/protected source.
